kitEvidence.formula:
Passive: Attacks deal an additional [2 / 4 / 6 + (0.03) × AD[statFormula=2]] true damage, stacking infinitely. Takedowns against champions and epic monsters leave behind a piece of Void Coral.

Active: Bel'Veth consumes a Void Coral, gaining [1] Lavender stack and activating her true form. Void Coral from void epic monsters causes minions that die nearby to become Void Remora. While casting, Bel'Veth Slows nearby enemies before exploding, dealing [150 / 200 / 250 + (1.5) × AP] + [20]% missing-Health true damage.

In her true form, Bel'Veth gains [100 / 250 / 400 + (1.5) × AD[statFormula=2] + (1.5) × AP] max Health, [25 / 75 / 125] Attack range, [(0.06 / 0.13 / 0.2) × 100]% Total Attack Speed, and Void Surge can pass through walls.

True form lasts [45] seconds, increased to [90] seconds at [40] Lavender stacks. At [80] Lavender stacks, true form lasts until death.

builds.name: Royal Maelstrom: finite missing-health channel
builds.summary: Investigate high one Royal Maelstrom channel core damage output under fixed, reproducible conditions; compare one-slot swaps instead of claiming a global maximum.
builds.goal: Investigate high one Royal Maelstrom channel core damage output under fixed, reproducible conditions; compare one-slot swaps instead of claiming a global maximum.
builds.hypothesis: Each strike starts at 10/12/14/16/18 + 0.12 total AD and can increase up to twofold with enemy missing health. The strike-count helper is 6 + 6 times (0.4 times the bonus-attack-speed stat term). Rounding, stat normalization and actual strike delivery require measurement; each strike sees the target health remaining at that instant.

builds.goal: Explore high last observed R-passive true packet in ten normal attacks output with a finite preparation; compare alternatives rather than claiming an absolute maximum.
